title.en: An Act Appropriating Two Hundred and Eighty thousand Pesos for the Construction of Additional Buildings in the Insular Psychopathic Hospital At Mandaluyong, Province of Rizal, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The sum of two hundred and eighty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in
the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the construction of additional buildings in the Insular
Psychopathic Hospital at Mandaluyong, Rizal.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 1, 1934.
